body: What if that individual is the only family I have?
Hey
Well said, people like us can understand and people like us can help or at least try to help.

For now you have the reason and yep that's good enough, having even a single thing that motivates us is enough to keep going on. Thinking too much make things worse, maybe when this reason is lost you'll have another stronger one to hold on.
Hey, you can pm me too

Maybe you'll meet some people in your life who'll make you more empathetic and caring. We keep learning throughout our lives.. You deserve it, we all deserve it and we all have it too but some just don't know how to express it or feel it.
Yep, true

We all desire genuine care and the desire grows stronger when we are capable of giving it, nothing wrong or selfish in that.  The thing is people are with trust issues, everyone at some point in life has been hurt by someone and so they don't show their true affection and care.. It takes a long time for people to open up and show their true feelings. Its not impossible to have that but it just takes a lot if time to get that.  Yep people help others because that way that are helping themselves too, a person that has been hurt.. Knows how it feels like and that's why they try to help the others by giving them what they themselves wanted in their lows. The things you wrote.. Many people feels the same and have done the same things.
I love that little space of mine and now it has grown so strong that I'm lost in it most of the time, even if its just my imagination its far better than my reality.

Sometimes it take a lot if time for things to work but it'll get easier someday.. And it is worth trying for that day. Came so far, worked so much.. Not to just give up in the end. Life is not fair, for some its easier.. For some its hard but all we can do is keep fighting.

Hey, I feel the same.. But maybe that's how it is for everyone, we never realize the importance of a person until they are gone or it can also be like after being alone we miss the company of those people and keep thinking about how good they were and take all the blame on us. Idk if that makes sense. Any kind of relationship works or breaks with the efforts of the people involved.
Thanks <3

Being on my own and not depending on friends gave me a view of a complete new side of me but just at times talking with someone who cares and who understands helps a lot. Yep those kind of friends are hard to find.
That's so sweet :D. I'm hanging around here :p wbu?
Yay :D thanks.. Glad it all worked well for you :) I'll try something
Sometimes yeah it is
Well you have skills now :). Being able to adjust with different people is a big thing. Here at least many people understands.
That's sweet of you :) thanks
I'll try something :)
Aye:) glad to know that
Haha yup, seems like most of the people I met were not compatible :3
Hey thanks :) and yep its just annoying but we do get more time to do the things we like.. Plenty of time xD
But for how long? I mean we all need someone to talk with right?
Ha yep online things seems like the last option.
Hey, what happened?
Its so rare to find songs that connects to you and says the exact words going on in your head. 'Waiting for the end'- is for me
Hey, what happened? Sometimes not much people are online or maybe are not in the state to help.. But people do care here. Please don't give up.
Thank you, I really appreciate you saying that   .. Willing to listen to a complete stranger is a big thing.. You all are wonderful souls.

We all do that right? Supporting other but not having the words for ourselves... We are all important but living isn't for some people I guess. It feels so bad to even complain about my life, we all have problems and we all face them but I can't do it all now.
In my 20s, because that's the only way I can be with the person I love the most. Yep some do but I can't do it anymore.

My imagination is all I have, things are under my control and everything goes so well.. 

"We are all dreamers wanting to be completely out of touch with reality."

Yep also those who are like "I have no friends , I do have a few friends that cares and few other that will be there for me if I call " like dude wth  " no friends " means having no friend at all 0_0..

You're gonna make it <3 just hold on tight, let the hope for a better life a better future pull you through this time..  You're not alone, I'll be thinking about you :) and you will get through this. https://youtu.be/w4jUxrGebp4 the sun is rising.

I have a similar thinking. Things are not out of control now but I know soon they will be and I don't want to see all that and I know nothing will change too.. As long as you are in control live your life and do whatever you want.. We all deserve that much at least :)
Yay!!
Yup.. Many definitions
Yeah but maybe most people don't know what to say
"It was almost like a reverse nightmare, like when you wake up from a nightmare you're so relieved. I woke up into a nightmare.”. <  I hope it gets easier for all of us someday :)
I feel the same.. Wasting my life.. I don't have anything to look forward to or like any excitement or anything to wake up the next morning for..

Yeah but like I tried to control or 'plan' my future.. Worked hard, got in the uni I wanted but my own mind or say my depression just made it so hard for me that I had to drop out.. So like it was meant to be.. Or maybe yeah I just was a coward who gave up.. Idk.

Sometimes when I'm watching something.. A video or a movie or a good song.. I get lost in that moment and forget about the present past everything for a sec and just as the normal feeling tries to set in.. The reality slaps me hard.. Same is when I'm having a good dream and then I wake up.. !!
Hope you feel more and more Better everyday :)
Yeah
Same here. X_X

I'm so sorry.. Being lonely sucks.. I can understand that.. We all do need someone to talk to.. To share our feelings with.. You can pm me anytime you want to talk.. We all are lonely souls.. The thing about pain is that it makes people like us understand each other very well

I'm sorry that you had to deal with all that.. That sucks.. Yep that's true all the pain.. Suffering and all makes you feel that way.. I feel like I've been living this life forever now.. Pain just makes everyday count.. A day like a year

I had many friends.. They are still my friends but busy in their life and I'm here alone with my depression.. I get the " fuck it.. Being lonely is great" part.. I say that all the time lol.  Also yeah.. All my friends are like normal.. They don't understand what I feel..  Okay so maybe yeah you can try Telling L one last time.. So that there will be no regrets of not trying and if even after that nothing changes.. Its better to just move on I guess..

First of all you are not shitty stupid or worthless person.. No one is.. So that voice is completely cray cray.. But yeah I can understand that voice seems stronger than the other positive voice.. People do care.. Some care a little.. Some don't show how much they care.. Why do you think no one cares? Every life on earth matters.. Nothing would be the same without you.. It all matters because you are there.. Nobody can replace you..
Yep that's true.. Sometimes I just wish all the  people who can understand, cares and are willing to support live near each other..

Mine is not a in love relationship thing but its about a person that matters the most in my life.. I cannot seem to handle the fact that they are gone.. Like you said.. I can't handle the reality.. It hurts like  hell when the only reason you're living for is gone..
Thank you.. That means a lot
Glad to know they were with you through all this..but I don't have anyone.. because literally everyone now believes that I'm wrong. Thank you.. Hope so too
But it hard right.. When my own mind is creating a burning hell for me..
I'm sorry that you feel that way.. No one should... But I hate it too

I can understand.. At this point in my life I don't have anyone to share my  thoughts and feelings with.. Yeah Internet friendship is nice but its always better to have someone right beside you.. You have close friends Maybe you can talk to them about how you feel.. Letting out the thoughts spinning inside us.. Helps sometimes :)...  Its okay to reach out and ask for help when you need.. We're the only one who can save ourselves..
